name: Distortion X Rådhuspladsen Friday – Zar Paulo, Lord Siva, Sira Jovina, Von Quar
description:
Distortion X Rådhuspladsen
Friday 5 June 2026
17.00-00.00
Copenhagen Town Hall Square


Surprise! We're moving into new and exciting territory together with Soundvenue.

We're bringing some of the best Danish pop and rock outfits to the streets – let's sing along, scream along and get goosebumps together.  

Zar Paulo, Lord Siva, Sira Jovina and Von Quar will share the stage at Distortion X Rådhuspladsen on Friday 5 June 2026. First time doing Rådhuspladsen on a Friday – expect fun happenings and DJs between the shows.

PS: We will still be doing X Rådhuspladsen on Wednesday 3 June 2026 – stay tuned
